units.name: Innovation, Strategy & Operations Cluster
units.evidence: Official research-cluster page identifies the business school and names sustainable operations/supply chains plus decision modelling and analysis among its research focus areas.

decisions.reason: Imported school-only row names no operations department. Computing faculty directory read; school label is not an operations unit.

limitations: Cluster heading says Innovation, Strategy & Operations Cluster; body uses Innovation, Strategy and Operations Management Cluster. Heading retained as canonical. Broad computing and engineering school names alone do not establish an operations unit.

sources.note: Named business research cluster and operations/supply-chain remit.
Imported Computing Science school faculty directory examined; no standalone operations unit established.
Five named engineering divisions and descriptions reviewed; no separately named industrial engineering/operations division shown.
